'''Pentecon XI Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ithaca, NY on 16 April 2000. [[Vincent Gu]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d530">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-15-pentecon-xi-april-16th-in-ithaca-nyd530/ pentecon-xi-april-16th-in-ithaca-ny], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 15 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-15-pentecon-xi-april-16th-in-ithaca-nyd530/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[Pentecon XI]].

* '''Date:''' 16 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Ithaca, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Vincent Gu]]
